title: E-bike with tapas
text:
The e-bike tour of Barcelona was fantastic! E-bikes made it easy to glide through the city and discover the main attractions such as the Sagrada Família, the Parc de la Ciutadella and the beach of Barceloneta. The guide was informative and friendly, and the ride itself was relaxed and enjoyable.

The two tapas stops made the tour perfect. We tasted delicious local specialties in authentic bars. An ideal combination of sightseeing and culinary delights – highly recommended!
author: 914graut

title: A Perfect Mix of Food and Fun!
text:
